title: Regularized regression protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Regularized regression should complete this objective: Compare Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand regularization.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Document preprocessing, validation setup, selected parameter, and metric.
